purpose: A create-only specification and bounded stdlib collector for checking existing small text metadata relevant to checkpoint-declared configuration candidates, active evaluator Namespace evidence, exact HUSTval15 DKP key identities, and per-cell cycle-length metadata.
lane: Retrospective author total-EOL HUST validation-only candidate. Not dynamic online RUL, not independent generalization, and not model-performance evidence.

authority.child_scope: design and create artifacts only; collector execution not authorized

stage_question: Do the fixed, already-existing small text evidence candidates contain (a) a checkpoint-declared args object that can be kept distinct from proposed val overrides and unknown active evaluator Namespace, (b) exact per-cell DKP key identities/presence for the frozen 15 cells, or (c) per-cell valid_cycle_number metadata?

fixed_population.source: fixed plan plus pinned split and current static pairing CSV

read_whitelist.role: checkpoint-declared args candidate; not active evaluator Namespace
draft proposal; val overrides are proposals only
existing archive-member metadata; args JSON is an archive member and was not read by this collector
prior aggregate restricted-decoder receipt; no new decode
fixed 15 rows, declared labels, and loader-rule DKP key candidates; not exact key presence
prior bounded source audit; one-cell historical cycle count, not a new payload read

collector_limits.wall_limit_mechanism: POSIX SIGALRM default termination at10seconds, plus deadline checks after parse and before atomic output publication
collector_limits.path_mechanism: root-from-slash and each directory via dirfd O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW; leaf via O_NOFOLLOW/fstat; output via pinned parent dirfd O_EXCL pending and no-overwrite hardlink

sha256_rules.input_bytes: Compute SHA-256 over exact bytes for each fixed whitelist file, require exact frozen expected hash before parsing, and report observed hash/byte count in receipt.
sha256_rules.plan_and_review_anchors: Pinned in this spec and manifest; not dynamically discovered by collector.
sha256_rules.output: Create-only metadata_receipt.json; refuse to overwrite an existing receipt.

semantic_partition.checkpoint_declared_args_candidate: Values only from data/processed/audit_only/PBT_seed42/args.json; label as declaration candidate and do not claim this is active eval state.
semantic_partition.proposed_validation_config: Values from the DRAFT JSON only; label every value proposed and not effective.
semantic_partition.effective_evaluator_namespace: Each requested field is represented with value=null, provenance to the considered candidate sources, and missing=true unless a whitelist source proves the actual checkpoint args plus exact CLI/run overrides. No parser defaults, shell examples, run names, or proposals may fill this object.
semantic_partition.dkp: For each of the fixed 15 cells emit exact key identity/presence value=null and missing=true unless an existing whitelist text artifact exposes the per-cell key. A filename-derived loader key is a separate candidate field and never evidence of presence. Aggregate 15/15 coverage stays aggregate only.
semantic_partition.cycle: For each of the fixed 15 cells emit valid_cycle_number value=null and missing=true unless an existing whitelist artifact supplies an exact per-cell loader-length value. Keep any old bounded cycle_count report separate, with its own provenance and limitations. Never infer length from label EOL, a filename, prefix projection, or another cell.

fail_closed_stops: Any fixed input missing, symlinked, non-regular, too large, over aggregate byte cap, invalid UTF-8, wrong SHA, or invalid JSON/CSV schema: stop before output.
Any population order/count mismatch, unsupported input type, or wall-time cap breach: stop before output.
Any need to search outside the fixed whitelist, read an archive member, inspect a binary/payload, decode pickle, or open a dynamic run object: stop and report missing; do not broaden collector scope.
stage0_can_verify: That the seven fixed text candidates still match their frozen SHA-256 and fit within byte/time/population limits.
Checkpoint-declared args candidate fields and their provenance, separated from the draft proposal.
Whether aggregate DKP metadata and the loader-rule-derived 15 filename keys are present in current static receipts, while keeping per-cell key presence missing.
Whether current fixed metadata exposes a per-cell valid_cycle_number; retain any one-cell historical cycle_count as separate reported evidence.
stage0_cannot_close: G2: exact 15 DKP key-to-array identity/presence/value binding and 15 valid_cycle_number=len(cycle_data) values remain unproven unless the bounded text inputs unexpectedly contain exact rows.
G2: runtime EOL/data-cycle association, eligibility, selected rows, masks, and collate IDs/shapes remain unproven.
G3: runtime environment equivalence, patched tokenizer/model asset identity, constructor side-effect equivalence, safe strict-load path/completion, and numerical/device equivalence remain unproven.
No row-count, prediction, metric, fit, online-RUL, independent-generalization, or SOTA claim.
required_next_review: Independent review of this exact directory and hashes, then root-only decision. Even after review, collector execution requires explicit root authorization; this artifact does not grant it.
repair_notes: v1 preserved; v2 only hardens fixed metadata stage safety/schema; no new sources or scientific GO
All seven JSON/CSV input pins unchanged; aggregate missing=false only after exact typed15/15 schema check
No runtime collector executed; ast.parse of collector source only; no tests

Output partial temp retained if SIGALRM kills process; never overwrite or auto retry; any failure requires new root decision. A completed receipt can exist if SIGALRM occurs immediately after atomic publication; root must verify exit status and artifact integrity before accepting.
